items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Hiawatha is a real name. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah? I never knew the right name.

ctx.x: The first piece I learned was that piece that my old boss used to play all the time. Lizzy on the Rails. I don't remember the real name of it, but that's what they used to call it.
Yeah? I never knew the right name.
